空间清理会自动删除文件吗？可以撤销吗？: Does cleanup delete files automatically? Can I undo it?
不会。扫描只列出候选，默认不选择任何文件，确认后才移到废纸篓；执行前会复查文件身: No. Scanning only lists candidates and selects nothing by default. Confirmed files are moved to Trash after identity and usage checks. Running apps, protected data and uncertain items are kept. General cleanup and other apps’ cache cleanup can be undone with ⌘Z in the current session. WeChat attachments can be recovered from Trash. Moving files to Trash does not immediately free disk space; usage figures are estimates.
为什么有些软件没有出现在软件清理列表？: Why are some apps missing from Software cleanup?

只扫描已下载到这台 Mac 的附件及可识别缓存，不读取或解密聊天数据库。手机独有: Only locally downloaded attachments and supported cache locations are scanned. Chat databases are not read or decrypted. Files that exist only on your phone or have not been downloaded to this Mac will not appear. You can add custom attachment folders; date filters use file modification times. Preview attachments before confirming a move to Trash.

Extraction uses a staging folder, and naming conflicts are saved separately without overwriting existing files. Archive creation currently supports ZIP.

打开安卓视频，会先下载完整文件吗？: Does opening an Android video download the entire file first?
不会。内置播放器按需从 MTP 读取字节范围，使用上限 32 MiB 的共享视频: No. The built-in player reads MTP byte ranges on demand into a shared video-data cache capped at 32 MiB, without saving a full video file. Closing or disconnecting cancels reads and frees the cache. This is not a total memory limit or a promise of zero operating-system swap writes. Unsupported codecs or devices report an error without a download fallback.
其它文档仍需只读本机副本，缓存目标为 2 GiB / 7 天，在准备文件时清理；: Other documents still need read-only local copies. The cache targets 2 GiB / seven days and is cleaned when preparing files; copies opened in the current session are retained for external apps and may exceed the target. Download explicitly for external players or unsupported formats. Manual downloads are never automatically deleted.
